//: When each job runs, in this Mac's local time. Save and it takes effect within a minute; nothing to restart. 'sop' is a file in sops/. 'tier' picks the model: fast (Haiku), voice (Sonnet) or deep (Opus). 'catchUpHours' runs a job the Mac slept through, if it wakes within that many hours of the time. Set 'enabled' to false to pause a job.
